info.name: Mountain Breath API
info.description:
Living API contract for the Mountain Breath backend.

**Rule (docs/RULES.md):** every commit that adds, changes, or removes a route must update this collection in the same commit — request, variables, and tests.

**Usage:** start the API (`air` or `go run ./cmd/api` in `backend/`), then send requests here, or use the Collection Runner to execute the whole suite with its tests as a smoke test.

Folders mirror the roadmap phases from docs/PROJECT_PLAN.md.

item.name: System
item.description: Operational endpoints — not part of the business API.

request.description: Liveness probe. Returns 200 with `{"status":"ok"}` while the server is up. Later used by Docker healthchecks (Phase 8) and the load balancer (Phase 9).

Sleeps 5 seconds, then responds. Registered only when `MB_ENV=dev`.

Purpose: observing graceful shutdown (Ctrl+C while this is in flight) and client-cancellation (abort the request and watch the server log `slow request abandoned by client`).

item.name: Catalog (Phase 2)
item.description: Coming in Phase 2: CRUD for categories, products, and variants under {{apiV1}} — /categories, /products, /products/:slug, admin endpoints.

item.name: Auth (Phase 4)
item.description: Coming in Phase 4: /auth/register, /auth/login, /auth/logout with session cookies.
